import sys
from collections import defaultdict

MOD = 10**9 + 7

def mod_pow(base, exp):
    res = 1
    while exp > 0:
        if exp & 1:
            res = (res * base) % MOD
        base = (base * base) % MOD
        exp >>= 1
    return res

def main():
    input = sys.stdin.read
    data = input().split()
    N = int(data[0])
    P_values = data[1:]
    P = [list(map(int, P_values[i*N:(i+1)*N])) for i in range(N)]
    
    node_map = {}
    count_nodes = 0
    trans_table = {}
    prob_arr = [0] * (1 << N)
    dp_arr = [[0] * (70003) for _ in range(2)]
    inv100 = 0
    
    def dfs(x):
        nonlocal count_nodes
        if x in node_map:
            return node_map[x]
        node_id = count_nodes + 1
        node_map[x] = node_id
        count_nodes += 1
        tmp = [0] * N
        for i in range(N):
            for j in range(1 << N):
                if (j & (1 << i)) != 0:
                    tmp[i] |= x[j]
        trans_table[node_id] = {}
        for mask in range(1 << N):
            temp = list(x)
            for j in range(N):
                if (mask & (1 << j)) != 0:
                    temp = [temp[k] | tmp[k] for k in range(N)]
            t = dfs(temp)
            trans_table[node_id][mask] = t
        return node_id

    start_mask = [0] * (1 << N)
    start_mask[0] = 1
    start_node = dfs(start_mask)
    inv100 = mod_pow(100, MOD - 2)
    print(len(node_map))
    
    for i in range(N):
        for j in range(N):
            P[i][j] = int(P[i][j])
    
    dp_arr[0][1] = 1
    layer = 0
    
    for i in range(N):
        for j in range(1 << N):
            prob_arr[j] = 1
            for k in range(N):
                p_value = P[i][k] if (j & (1 << k)) != 0 else 100 - P[i][k]
                prob_arr[j] = (prob_arr[j] * inv100) % MOD
                prob_arr[j] = (prob_arr[j] * p_value) % MOD
        for idx in range(len(dp_arr[1 - layer])):
            dp_arr[1 - layer][idx] = 0
        for j in range(1, len(dp_arr[layer])):
            if dp_arr[layer][j]:
                for k in range(1 << N):
                    t = trans_table[j][k]
                    dp_arr[1 - layer][t] = (dp_arr[1 - layer][t] + dp_arr[layer][j] * prob_arr[k]) % MOD
        layer = 1 - layer
    
    final_mask = [1] * (1 << N)
    final_mask = [0] * (1 << N)
    final_mask[(1 << N) - 1] = 1
    final_node = dfs(final_mask)
    print(dp_arr[layer][final_node])

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
